mapper.sql: select b.benchmark_id, b.program_id, s.school_name, p.program_name, s.country, p.difficulty, b.ref_line, b.stability, b.source, b.sample_size, b.del_flag, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark from abr_program_benchmark b join abr_program p on p.program_id = b.program_id join abr_school s on s.school_id = p.school_id
mapper.insert: insert into abr_program_benchmark (program_id, ref_line, stability, source, sample_size, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{programId}, #{refLine}, #{stability}, #{source}, #{sampleSize}, '0', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_program_benchmark set ref_line = #{refLine}, stability = #{stability}, source = #{source}, sample_size = #{sampleSize}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where benchmark_id = #{benchmarkId} and del_flag = '0'
